status: Pre-E4-result specification; freeze complete runner/source snapshots before any E4 inference
scope: Post-E3 exploratory mechanism diagnosis on the same exposed E2/E3 development items; not fresh confirmatory evidence
trigger: E3 observed all five zero-D arms yielding no throughout both phenomena and all three seeds (2676 saved rows), including no_delta with A and B retained. This observation generated the E4 hypothesis; it is not an E4 result.
question: Can the unchanged D=B-A block reproduce the frozen reader without raw A/B blocks, and is the reader sensitive to D sign or coordinate arrangement beyond its scalar energy?

population.selection: Copy the original items.jsonl and pairs.npz bytes unchanged; no new selection, exclusion, label or training data
population.allowed_arms: All four E4 arms for every retained item, including 51 hard_neg items. Original items.allowed_arms remains E3 provenance only; E4 expected coverage is explicitly 209*4*3
population.primary: The unchanged 57 flood source-positive tiles with paired pos/neg items, all ten flood events; no C1 support exclusion
population.landslide: Unchanged 44 source-paired items in two regions; descriptive only
population.hard_negative: All 51 retained flood hard negatives, all four arms; separate descriptive FPR, never included in paired primary BA

arms.delta_only: [0,0,D]; retain original D unchanged, including its information from both source observations
arms.delta_sign_flip: [A,B,-D]; preserve A and B and their original order; isolate difference-block sign from the E3 reverse-arm frame swap
arms.delta_feature_permute: [A,B,P(D)], P(D)[:,j]=D[:,(j+257)%768]; fixed coordinate permutation identical across tokens, items and seeds; no random draws or search

input_contract.prompt: Byte-equivalent original E2/E3 chat prompt and date strings; original flood dates remain known approximations
input_contract.delta_arithmetic: Compute B-A once in source float32, reject nonfinite; transform only the explicitly specified blocks
input_contract.norm_control_check: Fixed feature permutation preserves each token's values as a multiset; mean, variance and L2 are checked in float64 with rtol=1e-6 and atol=1e-6, not bitwise reduction equality
input_contract.permutation_justification: A deterministic nonzero permutation preserves scalar energy and feature-value distribution while disturbing coordinate-specific content. It is a descriptive control for simple nonzero/norm gating and remains out of distribution. Sign flip alone changes the feature mean, so it does not replace this control.

validity.reference: Both E3 v1 saved real responses and original saved E2 real responses, separately in every seed and phenomenon
validity.execution_order: Generate all three real arms first and pass all reproduction/parse checks before opening any E4 intervention output file
validity.parse_scope: Every seed/phenomenon/arm including retained hard negatives
validity.finite: All selected pair tensors, difference blocks, checkpoints and projected tokens finite; generation logits have no NaN/+Inf and at least one finite value
validity.coverage: Exactly 2508 unique (seed,arm,id) keys; original source_gold unchanged; transformed_gold explicitly null
validity.failure: Invalid run with partial outputs and reason preserved; no repair by exclusion, threshold relaxation or result-dependent permutation changes

primary_analysis.unit: Equal flood-event mean of original source-label balanced agreement on pos/neg pairs
primary_analysis.contrast: delta_only minus real on the same items within each event
primary_analysis.eligibility: At least five represented paired flood events and real macro BA >=0.60 per seed
primary_analysis.difference_block_sufficient_under_interv: In at least two of three eligible seeds, delta_only macro BA >=0.60 and paired delta CI lower >=-0.05
primary_analysis.delta_only_degrades_source_agreement: If sufficiency is not met: in at least two eligible seeds, delta_only delta <=-0.10 and paired CI upper <0
primary_analysis.mixed_or_inconclusive: Otherwise; no interpretation as equality or absence of mechanism

secondary_descriptive.prediction_agreement: Per seed/phenomenon, real-vs-delta_only matched valid yes/no decisions divided by all source items; even null/null counts as nonagreement. Report >=0.99 flag descriptively, plus parsed coverage and both-parsed agreement. This flag does not determine the primary verdict.
secondary_descriptive.sign_and_permutation: Report source-label BA, paired event deltas/CIs and decisions compared with real; no extra success threshold, arm selection or follow-up tuning
secondary_descriptive.hard_negative: Separate source-label yes FPR with unparsed counts; no transformed physical gold
secondary_descriptive.landslide: Two descriptive region means; no tile-independent confidence interval

compute.gpu: Use an idle authorized GPU with inherited cooperative locks; record UUID, selected index and runtime; never alter the E3 directories
compute.runner: New E4 runner and frozen source snapshot; reuse unchanged model/projector loading and decoding recipe from audited E3 v1

limits: D=B-A already contains both source observations. Delta-only sufficiency cannot imply that the earlier observation or historical information is unnecessary.
Removing raw A/B blocks while retaining D tests representation routing under a frozen reader, not single-image performance.
Sign reversal and coordinate permutation create out-of-distribution embeddings; sensitivity does not prove temporal or physical change reasoning.
The E3 zero-D collapse generated this experiment; this is sequential exploration on already exposed development data, not a fresh confirmatory trial.
Original flood labels and pre/pre absence assumptions are not independently verified temporal gold; imputed prompt dates are retained.
No training, new pseudo-labels, threshold/permutation sweep, or per-item repair is allowed. Any next experiment needs a separate frozen plan.

Permutation preserves raw input D statistics only. The learned coordinate-dependent projector may change projected norms/energy, so this control cannot exclude every downstream norm or gating mechanism.
